content.content: An operation's footprint is the set of op-log entries the operation created inside its run window that are attributed to the invoking workspace; entries the same window carries from other workspaces are not the operation's.
content.rationale: The window bounds which entries are candidates and attribution decides which of them are the operation's own, so concurrent work sharing a window is never read as the operation's. Undo and redo act on what an operation created, so what counts as an operation's own work is fixed once, here, where the bracketing and the op log meet.
